ValidationRule.description: Sales rep cannot edit repeat business opps if previous opp field is empty
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( (ISPICKVAL(Type, "Repeat Business") || ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto-Repeat Business")) && ISBLANK(Previous_Opportunity__c) && ($Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR' && $Profile.Name <> 'ALM - Custom: Fin/Ops/HR') && ($User.ProfileId = '00e6g000000WHKt') && NOT(CONTAINS(TEXT(Owner.Team__c), 'Event')) && NOT(CONTAINS(TEXT(Owner.Team__c), "MBL Seminars")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunities classified as 'Repeat Business' or 'Auto-Repeat Business' must have a specified previous opportunity. Contact crm support if you require immediate assistance.
